title.narrative: Output 7.1. Increased capacity of Member States to ensure respect for, promote and realize fundamental principles and rights at work

description.narrative:
Since 2021, Provincial Plans of Action (PoA) for the prevention and reduction of child labour (2021-25) were developed and adopted by the Respective Provincial People’s Committee and implemented in all 63 provinces. New Provinces have developed and adopted their own Provincial Plan of Action in 2023 for the prevention and reduction of child labour. These are hence new results reported in 2023.
Other national programmes in the period of 2021-2025 with a vision to 2030, incorporating contents related to the elimination of the worst forms of child labour were developed and endorsed by the PM, namely, the Program on Protecting and supporting children to interact healthily and creatively in the online environment in the period of 2021 - 2025; National Action Plan for Children 2021-2030. With funding from the Government of the United States, ILO provided training to strengthen the capacity of tripartite partners in the implementation and supervision, and monitoring of the PoA to concerned staff of all 63 provinces and cities. Also, documents on intervention models and good practices, lessons learnt including IEC materials were reprinted for dissemination to all 63 provinces/cities for reference in implementing the PoAs. ILO-supported targeted livelihood interventions for households with children engaged in or at risk of child labour in selected areas were implemented to scale up successful models across the country as part of support to implementing the National Action Plan to Prevent and Reduce Child Labour, in general, and particularly the PoAs for the Period 2021-2025 and in implementing the Alliance 8.7. For example, in An Giang province, at least 150 target households received livelihood support through training courses on mud-free eel farming techniques and mushroom growing techniques for 57 households. ILO supported technical training on pig farming and taro/chive cultivation in Trung Hoa commune and Hoang Dieu in Chuong My district, Hanoi. ILO's results, successes, and lessons learned from the implementation of the ILO's Technical Assistance to Strengthen National Capacity to Prevent and Reduce Child Labour in Viet Nam (ENHANCE) were used in the development and endorsement of the Program on Protecting and supporting children to interact healthily and creatively in the online environment in the period of 2021 - 2025; and National Action Plan for Children 2021-2030.
